title: Basil server configuration
description: Basil's own settings only, read from Configurations/appsettings.json. Settings owned by ASP.NET or other libraries (Kestrel, AllowedHosts, ConnectionStrings, Logging:LogLevel) are documented by their owners. Policy that can change while the server runs (rate limits, locks, sessions, uploads...) is stored in the database and changed through the HTTP API or the console. Any key can also be given as an environment variable (Basil__Server__Domain) or on the command line (--Basil:Server:Domain=...), which win over the file.

Logging.description: Basil's own log file and queue settings.

File.description: The log files. A change applies after the server restarts.

Location.description: The folder of the log files, relative to the executable.

Interval.description: After this interval a new file starts.

MaxSize.description: The size, such as 100MB, at which a new file starts before the interval ends. Empty or 0 for no limit.

MaxAge.description: How long a log file is kept after its last write, as d.hh:mm:ss. 0 for no limit.

MaxFiles.description: How many log files are kept, the newest first. 0 for no limit.

MaxSize.description: The total size, such as 1GB, of the kept log files. Empty or 0 for no limit.

QueueCapacity.description: How many log events wait to be written before the newest are dropped and counted. A change applies after the server restarts.

OpenTelemetry.description: OpenTelemetry export, off by default. A change applies after the server restarts.

Server.description: Who the server is and how clients find it. A change applies after the server restarts.

Name.description: The name the server calls itself, for example in telemetry.

Domain.description: The public domain clients use to reach the server. Must not be an IP address.

TrustedProxies.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges whose client address and country headers are trusted.

Port.description: The plain TCP port of the IRC host (irc.<Domain>); it has no TLS. 0 picks a free port.

Enabled.description: Answer multicast DNS queries for the domain and its sub-domains, so clients on the same network resolve them without a hosts entry.

UseIPv4.description: Answer on IPv4; false switches that family off.

UseIPv6.description: Answer on IPv6; false switches that family off.

DnsTtl.description: How many seconds a client may keep an answer.

Storage.description: A change applies after the server restarts.

Location.description: The folder of the replays, avatars, beatmapsets and cache, relative to the executable.

Assets.description: A change applies after the server restarts.

CacheDirectory.description: The folder for the temporary files made while audio previews are built; empty uses Previews inside the cache of the storage location.

FfmpegFolder.description: The folder that holds the ffmpeg executable; empty finds it on the PATH.

Database.description: The database. A change applies after the server restarts.

Provider.description: The database engine the read connection reaches. Empty uses the engine of Write.

PoolSize.description: The most connections the reading pool holds. 0 keeps the driver's default.

Provider.description: The database engine the write connection reaches. It also runs the migrations.

PoolSize.description: How many connections may store changes at the same time.

Updates.description: The check for a newer release, which never installs anything. A change applies at once.

Source.description: A GitHub repository URL or a plain release feed URL.

CheckOnStartup.description: Look for a newer release when the server starts.

Channel.description: The channel of releases to look at: stable, or the name of another published channel.
